text: Aris wrote that R. came about the machines again. She told him no, and he said she'd regret it.
Tobias heard shouting and breaking glass from the maker space just before midnight.
Kofi saw a grey-haired man in a red top and sunglasses run from the maker space at midnight, holding his arm.

leads.text: Grey hair, a red top and sunglasses at midnight. Raymond dresses like that: ask him where he was.

text: Raymond says he and Aris always got on fine.
